reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

flags.reason: generalises-example: The evidence describes how the guide page is set up: "so the page hosts every link in a Coin `VStack`, as an app would." The entry turns that page fixture into general placement advice. The inline-element behaviour is web-only and applies to a plain block parent, not to app layouts in general.

stronger-than-source: The evidence says only that "the page does not recommend recolouring links". Not recommending something is not the same as discouraging it. The stated reason is also specific to Primary ("low-contrast gold on white"), but the item marks all Text Appearance recolouring as discouraged, including Secondary and Error, which the evidence does not criticise.

notes: /facts/gaps/2 is dated 2026-10-01, but the claim about Figma variants comes from the 29 September sources section. The guide's 1 October sources line repeats it, so this is minor. /accessibility/1 describes 0.1.78 behaviour; on 0.1.77, Enter did not fire onPress and a disabled link stayed focusable (#174).
